acceptanceCriteria: One command closes every OPEN ticket that `ticket batch-delivered` lists as delivered for a merged batch PR, each through the normal writer route with evidence binding the green CI run and the merge commit.
--dry-run prints the exact per-ticket plan and writes nothing; a rerun after success is a no-op for COMPLETED tickets.
Mentioned-only, HELD and live-attempt tickets are not closed and are reported with a reason code and recovery.
Focused tests cover success, rerun idempotence, a held ticket, a live attempt and a missing green run; the spec records numbered requirements.
body: Observed 2026-10-22: after each batch merge the orchestrator closes 15-60 tickets with a hand-written loop of `ticket complete-manual` calls (one canonical payload, expected revision and request id per ticket; evidence = sha256 of the CI run URL and the merge sha). `ticket batch-delivered` already lists the delivered tickets with batch PR, merge commit and green CI runs, but it is read-only and aimed at gate run/complete, which lanes do not use. ATTEMPT_LIVE refusals also need a manual show/reap per ticket. Build one writer-route command (e.g. `ticket close-delivered --pr N --prs FILE --runs FILE [--dry-run]`) that closes each delivered OPEN ticket with that evidence, skips COMPLETED ones idempotently, and reports (never auto-reaps) live attempts with their recovery.
title: Tasks: close every ticket a merged batch PR delivered in one command, from batch-delivered output
